findings.rationale: The file's mtime is 2026-10-11, but its change time is 2026-11-10 10:28:56, just after the 23 MB flow. This suggests the mtime was set back. The fs_stat snapshot is host-writable, so this is not conclusive.
verifier_notes: the time window is wider than 30 minutes; too broad to verify
findings.skeptic_note: Single host-writable point-in-time snapshot; mtime earlier than ctime is explained by preserved timestamps or extraction.

findings.rationale: Tap flow from workstation 10.20.1.21 sent 23.18 MB to 10.20.9.62:8080, an unapproved destination above the 5 MB bulk threshold. Staff file cache-0a91.bin of matching size exists on the workstation.
verifier_notes: bulk transfer to a destination not on the approved list, cited via the flow record
findings.skeptic_note: Flow to unapproved 10.20.9.62:8080 of 23.18 MB; size matches the staged file. Supported by the tap witness.

findings.rationale: Admin account adm-tkim logged into records from 10.20.1.21, which is the workstation's address and not an admin source. The session ran the log-forwarder stop.
verifier_notes: a session on this host was opened from another monitored host outside the stated access policy
findings.skeptic_note: Admin session from workstation address, outside the listed admin sources. Spoofing not excluded.

findings.rationale: adm-tkim stopped the log-forwarder via sudo in session 402 on records. No approved change record in the brief covers this.
verifier_notes: a recorded stop command opens this collection gap and no approved change record covers it
findings.skeptic_note: Log-forwarder stop by adm-tkim in session 402 with no approved change record; collector copy corroborates.

findings.rationale: Outbound 23 MB transfer from 10.20.0.10 went to 10.20.0.45 (stor-nas-01), an approved backup and log archive destination, so it is consistent with transfer policy. The source host is not identified in the flow record.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation
findings.skeptic_note: Destination is the approved stor-nas-01 archive; policy-consistent.
